view.scene_description: The image depicts the interior of a large warehouse or storage facility. The space is filled with tall metal shelving units, some painted blue and others white, arranged in rows along both sides of the aisle. These shelves are stocked with various items, including cardboard boxes and plastic containers. The floor appears to be made of concrete, and there's a noticeable amount of debris scattered across it. In the background, two workers can be seen; one wearing a yellow vest and red pants, and another in a white shirt and black pants. The ceiling is high, with fluorescent lighting illuminating the area. The overall atmosphere suggests an active work environment where goods are stored and possibly sorted or distributed.

objects.label: Metal shelving unit
objects.observation: A tall metal shelving unit with blue paint on the frame and white shelves. It is located on the left side of the aisle and contains several stacked items, including cardboard boxes and plastic containers. The unit has multiple levels, each with horizontal bars for support. There is a visible attachment evidence indicating that it is securely installed in the warehouse.

objects.label: Cardboard box
objects.observation: A brown cardboard box is placed on the floor near the bottom right corner of the image. It appears to be empty and is partially obscured by other objects in the scene.

objects.label: Plastic container
objects.observation: A clear plastic container is positioned on the middle shelf of the shelving unit on the left side of the aisle. It is rectangular in shape and appears to be empty.

objects.label: Concrete floor
objects.observation: The floor of the warehouse is made of concrete and extends throughout the entire visible area. It is gray in color and has a rough texture. There is debris scattered across the floor, including small pieces of paper and other materials.

objects.label: Debris
objects.observation: Scattered debris can be seen on the concrete floor, including small pieces of paper and other materials. This indicates that the warehouse is actively used and may not be regularly cleaned.

objects.label: Fluorescent lighting
objects.observation: The ceiling of the warehouse is equipped with fluorescent lights, which provide bright illumination throughout the space. The lights are evenly spaced and cover the entire ceiling area.

objects.label: Ceiling
objects.observation: The ceiling of the warehouse is high and features fluorescent lighting. It is white in color and has a smooth surface. The lighting fixtures are attached to the ceiling and provide ample illumination for the workspace.

objects.label: Workers
objects.observation: Two workers can be seen in the background of the image. One worker is wearing a yellow vest and red pants, while the other is dressed in a white shirt and black pants. They appear to be engaged in their tasks within the warehouse environment.

view.extraction: 2 literal JSON document(s) for display only; 0 trailing characters retained in raw

prompts.native_user_prompt:
<image>Inspect the photograph. Return ONLY one JSON object, no markdown or text outside JSON. Describe the complete scene and list visible objects with separate local integer IDs, separating instances when possible. For every object describe visible appearance, image-relative location, occlusion, supports, contacts and relationships. State uncertainty; do not infer hidden fasteners, weight or permanent installation. Do not classify stability or mobility. Use English text.
Required JSON structure (the angle-bracket text specifies field meaning, not example objects):
{"scene_description":"<full scene description>","objects":[{"id":1,"label":"<visible object name>","observation":"<visible appearance, location, occlusion, supports, contacts and relations>","attachment_evidence":"not_visible","identifiable":true}]}
List all discernible objects, not just one. Every object needs these five fields. attachment_evidence must be visible_installation, appears_freestanding, not_visible or mixed; visible_installation requires visible mounting or integration. Use not_visible when attachment cannot be established. scene_description about 120 words or fewer; each observation about 60 words or fewer.

Describe the photograph using these inputs:
{"frame_id": "loco-s2-34451", "image_size": [1920, 1080], "annotation_kind": "unspecified", "supplied_objects": null}
